mechanism: Minoxidil causes sodium and water retention which may antagonize the diuretic effects of norethindrone and increase fluid accumulation; norethindrone may slightly affect minoxidil metabolism via hepatic CYP3A4.
action: Monitor blood pressure and fluid retention; counsel patient on sodium restriction; norethindrone use does not contraindicate topical minoxidil but systemic minoxidil requires careful cardiovascular monitoring.
